title: Edit, in a second message, the file the first one made
prompt: Add a function `greet(name)` that returns `Hello, <name>!` (so greet("Ann") is "Hello, Ann!"). Put it in a new file of your choosing somewhere under src/, and export it as a named export. Don't change the other files.
followUps: Now give that function an optional second parameter, `greeting`, defaulting to "Hello", so greet("Ann", "Hi") returns "Hi, Ann!".
